Both jobs (64107 and 64115 on east) failed in the same task, "Fetch the gateway bundle through the egress proxy" in the ocp4_workload_orchid_gateway role. In each, get_url could not complete the TLS handshake with egress-proxy-02.dmz.example.net on port 8443: "Request failed: <urlopen error [SSL: SSLV3_ALERT_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE] sslv3 alert handshake failure>".

Icinga does not monitor that host: a host search for egress-proxy-02.dmz.example.net returned an empty list, so there is no host or service check for the proxy at all.

The only open Icinga problem is the CRITICAL service "ESXi hardware health" (esxi-health) on host esxi-r07-n12.virt.example.net. Its check output reads: "CRITICAL - ESXi health API on esxi-r07-n12.virt.example.net returned HTTP 500 Internal Server Error (CIM provider sfcb-smx_sensor not responding)".

That alert does not explain the job failures. It is on a different host, an ESXi hypervisor, and it reports an HTTP 500 from that host's health API, not a TLS handshake failure. Nothing in the jobs' logs touches esxi-r07-n12, and nothing in Icinga links it to the proxy. The failures point at the TLS endpoint of egress-proxy-02.dmz.example.net:8443, which Icinga cannot tell us anything about because it is not monitored. Check the proxy's TLS listener directly, and consider adding it to Icinga.
